regime_context: This is a China A-shares tape where the detector itself flags gate_helps=false — the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history, so the one validated edge is absent here and the whole framework is mean-revert/experimental. Momentum rank is an attention lens, not alpha, and rotation timing is display-only; the one-narrative concentration is extreme (only 2 of 22 themes eligible, Coal well ahead).
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks (512800.SS) overtakes Coal as the top durable+eligible theme while Coal's breadth stays below ~0.5 and Banks stays above ~0.9 breadth for 10+ sessions — that would retire the 'Coal one-narrative holds' watch; this is a confirmed-handoff observation only, not a prediction.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible rank-2 theme with trend-like durability (bar 0.78, hurst_tag trend) and high breadth (0.94), which is the detector's strongest coincident read on genuine participation rather than a thin attention spike. They are not the leader (Coal is) but are the most persistent broad-based eligible theme; the lean is on continuity of that persistence, not on alpha.
evidence: crowded true (z 1.74) — this is a size-down caution only, not a fade
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.74 is high and the guardrails warn crowding marks co-tops; on a mean-reverting tape a crowded 'trend' is precisely the classic late chase, and the detector's own track_record dir_accuracy is only 0.34.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags Coal ETF 515220.SS by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal leads the one-narrative structure with score 1.1 but has marginal durability (bar 0.54), a mean-revert hurst tag, and only half breadth (0.5). With gate_helps=false and the detector's own warning that flow spikes mark tops (guardrail: do not treat attention spikes as a buy), there is no supported case to overweight the top rank; the avoid lean simply declines to endorse chasing the leader.
evidence: r10 only 0.0252 — low recent dispersion of strength
theses.dissent: Coal is the actual leader and the guardrails explicitly warn NOT to fade the dominant theme on a crowding flag (and it isn't even crowded here); risking avoidance of a genuine trending leader is a real cost.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS holds above the CSI 300 benchmark and Coal stays rank 1 with breadth above 0.7 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar is deep ineligible (rank 21, score -0.805) and shows extreme negative crowding (z -2.15), which usually signals either a cold theme or a co-bottom, neither of which supports an over- or underweight here under the size-down-only crowding rule. The avoid is a conscious refusal to take either side on a theme the detector has no trend signal for.
theses.dissent: Extreme negative crowding combined with a mean-revert tape could mark an oversold theme ripe for a bounce, which would make avoidance a missed asymmetric opportunity.

falsifier.text: Solar ETF 515790.SS outpaces the CSI 300 by more than 5% and Solar moves back into eligible ranks before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
